rationale: Table2.tex row 3 ('Missing jobs below new MW ($\Delta$ b)') reports the demographic-subsample Δb estimates. Column (1) = -0.065*** (SE 0.010) corresponds to 'Less than high school' and column (2) = -0.032*** (SE 0.007) corresponds to 'High school or less'. These exactly match the claim's paper_value of less_than_high_school = -0.065 and high_school_or_less = -0.032 (0% relative error), well within the 5% match band. The relevant estimation was a documented Stata->R/fixest port (fix_severity.json, 'major' but environment-driven, not a methodological flaw), which did not affect the produced Table2 values reported here.
